## The Ultimate Guide: Slack + ClickUp + Manus AI

---

### Part 1: Integrating Slack with ClickUp

**Setup (4 Steps):**
1. Go to ClickUp's **App Center** and find the Slack integration.
2. Click **Connect and Authorize** to grant access to your Slack workspace.
3. Select which **channels and events** to sync (task creation, comments, status changes, etc.).
4. **Test it** — create a task from a Slack message and confirm it appears in ClickUp.

**What you get natively:**
- Create ClickUp tasks directly from Slack messages (context preserved)
- Real-time notifications for task updates, assignments, and comments
- Rich link previews in both directions (Slack ↔ ClickUp)
- Activity syncing to keep async teams aligned

---

### Part 2: Adding Manus AI to the Stack

Manus plugs into Slack in **three distinct modes**, and connects to ClickUp via its **MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server**:

| Mode | How It Works | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Manus Agent (DM)** | Chat with Manus like a colleague in a dedicated Slack DM. Has persistent memory. | Private drafting, daily briefings, on-the-go execution |
| **Slack Integration (@mention)** | Tag `@manus` in any channel thread. It reads context, executes, and posts results. | Instant PRDs, document analysis, team-facing deliverables |
| **Slack Connector (MCP)** | Triggered from the Manus web app; reads/sends Slack messages on your behalf. | Automated reporting, cross-channel synthesis |

**Connecting Manus to ClickUp via MCP:**
1. In the Manus web app, go to **Connectors** and add a new connector.
2. Enter ClickUp's MCP server URL: `https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp`
3. Authenticate via **OAuth** — Manus can now manage tasks, build reports, and search your ClickUp workspace using natural language.

**Real-World Workflow Examples:**
- **Instant PRD:** Team debates a feature in Slack → tag `@manus` → it drafts a full PRD, creates a ClickUp task, and posts the link back in the thread.
- **Automated Weekly Report:** Manus reads `#engineering-commits` every Friday, cross-references completed ClickUp tasks, and posts a summary to `#company-announcements` on your behalf.
- **Intelligent Triage:** Incoming customer request in Slack → Manus analyzes priority, creates a structured ClickUp task, and assigns it to the right person — automatically.

---

### Part 3: ClickUp vs. Monday.com — Slack Integration Comparison

| Feature | ClickUp + Slack | Monday.com + Slack |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Task Creation** | From Slack messages, with context preserved | From Slack messages |
| **Notification Control** | Highly customizable per event type | Basic alerts; can cause notification clutter |
| **Two-Way Sync** | Strong bidirectional with rich link previews | Primarily one-way (Monday → Slack) |
| **Automation Depth** | Native custom triggers + Zapier | Limited natively; Zapier required for complexity |
| **AI Agent (MCP) Support** | Full MCP server support for Manus and other AI agents | No native MCP server support |

**Bottom line:** Monday.com covers the basics well, but ClickUp's deeper customization, bidirectional sync, and MCP support make it the clear winner for teams that want to leverage AI agents like Manus.

---

### Part 4: Other Recommended Platforms

| Platform | Best For | Slack Integration Strength |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Notion** | Knowledge-heavy teams; docs + tasks | AI agents can read/reply in Slack channels |
| **Linear** | Software engineering & product teams | Optimized for developer workflows; fast and focused |
| **Asana** | Traditional project management | Highly reliable; praised for ease of use |
| **Wrike** | Complex, cross-functional work | Customizable dashboards + real-time Slack notifications |

---

assistant_message.content: Let me investigate this — I'll check the current state of ClickUp's App Center, known issues with the Slack integration visibility, and common troubleshooting steps to get it showing up for you.

No worries — this is a very common issue. There are a few specific reasons Slack won't appear in ClickUp's App Center, and two different ways to connect it. Here's the full breakdown:

---

## Why Slack Isn't Showing in ClickUp's App Center

### Most Likely Causes

**1. You're not a Workspace Owner or Admin**
This is the #1 reason. ClickUp requires you to be a **Workspace Owner or Admin** to enable the Slack integration via the App Center. Regular members, guests, and limited members cannot see or connect it. Check your role by going to **Settings → Members**.

**2. You're looking in the wrong place**
The Slack integration is not always visible as a tile in the App Center grid view. You need to **search for it** specifically. In the App Center, use the search bar and type "Slack" — it may not appear when just browsing.

**3. Your Workspace is already connected to a different Slack workspace**
ClickUp only allows **one Slack workspace per ClickUp Workspace** at a time. If someone else already connected it, it may appear as already configured rather than as a new option to add.

**4. A Slack admin has restricted app installations**
On the Slack side, your Slack workspace admin may have restricted which apps can be installed. You'd need your Slack admin to approve ClickUp in **Slack → Settings → Manage Apps**.

---

## Two Ways to Connect (Try Method 2 if Method 1 Fails)

### Method 1: Via ClickUp Settings (Recommended)
1. Click your **avatar** in the top-left corner of ClickUp.
2. Select **Integrations** (not App Center — this is a different path).
3. Find and click the **Slack tile**.
4. Click **Allow** to authorize the connection.

> Note: The path is **Avatar → Integrations → Slack**, not through the App Center browse grid.

### Method 2: Install from the Slack App Directory (Bypass ClickUp entirely)
1. Open **Slack** and click **Apps** in the left sidebar.
2. Search for **"ClickUp"** in the Slack App Directory.
3. Click **Add to Slack** and complete the OAuth flow.
4. This installs ClickUp into Slack directly, giving you `/clickup` slash commands immediately.

---

## Quick Checklist

| Check | What to Do |
| :--- | :--- |
| Are you a Workspace Owner/Admin? | Go to **Settings → Members** and verify your role |
| Did you search (not browse) the App Center? | Use the search bar and type "Slack" |
| Is Slack already connected by someone else? | Ask your workspace admin if it's already set up |
| Is your Slack admin blocking app installs? | Ask your Slack admin to whitelist ClickUp |
| Still not working? | Try Method 2 — install from the Slack App Directory directly |

If none of these resolve it, the fastest fix is to go directly to the [ClickUp app on the Slack Marketplace](https://slack.com/marketplace/A3G4A68V9-clickup) and click **Add to Slack** from there. That bypasses the App Center entirely and gets you connected in under a minute.
